name: GLASSLYCFW/2
purpose: Glassly copy on the onboarding, waiting and no-phone screens (English and Chinese tables) on the mainline 1.1.5.1 firmware. String-only: every replacement is at most the original's byte length and NUL padded; no code, pointer, length or layout changes. The Bluetooth name prefix (Nimo-) is untouched.

source.provenance: Rebuilt byte for byte from the vendor app's OTA to Nimo-4026 (HCI capture 2026-11-09)
